# rx_bloc_cli — GitHub Copilot Instructions

This is a **Dart CLI package** that generates Flutter projects via Mason bricks. The workspace has two distinct layers: the **CLI tool itself** (`lib/src/`) and the **mason brick templates** (`mason_templates/bricks/`). Always be clear which layer you are working on.

## Core Principles

- **Never edit `lib/src/templates/*.dart` by hand** — these are auto-generated by `bin/compile_bundles.sh` from the mason bricks.
- **`CreateCommandArguments` is the single source of truth** for all CLI flags. Every new feature flag starts there.
- **`BundleGenerator` controls what gets included** in the generated project. Feature bricks are merged in conditionally based on `GeneratorArguments`.
- **Processors run after mason generation** to patch platform files (AndroidManifest, plist, podfile, gradle) that cannot be expressed in Mustache.

## Source Architecture (`lib/src/`)

```
commands/           → create_command.dart — main CLI command
models/             → GeneratorArguments, BundleGenerator, configurations
  command_arguments/  → CreateCommandArguments enum (all CLI flags live here)
  configurations/     → AuthConfiguration, FeatureConfiguration, ProjectConfiguration, ShowcaseConfiguration
  readers/            → Typed argument readers from ArgResults
processors/         → Post-generation file mutators (Android, iOS, CI/CD, IDE)
templates/          → AUTO-GENERATED — do not edit
extensions/         → Dart extension methods
utils/              → Shared utilities
```

## Mason Brick Conventions

- Bricks live in `mason_templates/bricks/<brick_name>/`.
- Conditional content uses `{{#flag}}...{{/flag}}` / `{{^flag}}...{{/flag}}`.
- Conditional directories use `{{#flag}}dirname{{/flag}}` as the directory name.
- Template variables are defined in the vars dict in `create_command.dart`.
- After editing a brick, always run `bin/compile_bundles.sh` to regenerate the bundle.

## Feature Flag Checklist

When adding a new feature flag, touch all of the following:

1. `lib/src/models/command_arguments/create_command_arguments.dart` — add enum value
2. `lib/src/models/configurations/<relevant>_configuration.dart` — add field
3. `lib/src/models/generator_arguments.dart` — delegate to config
4. `lib/src/models/bundle_generator.dart` — conditionally add brick files; **enforce any hard dependencies** (see below)
5. `lib/src/commands/create_command.dart` — add to vars dict and `_usingLog`
6. Relevant `lib/src/processors/` if platform files need patching
7. `mason_templates/bricks/<new_brick>/` — create or extend the brick
8. `bin/compile_bundles.sh` — add `create_mason_bundle <brick_name>`
9. `bin/generate_test_project.sh` — add the flag to `all_enabled` and `all_disabled` configs

## Feature Cross-Dependencies

When a brick **imports code from another brick** (not just `package:widget_toolkit` which is a base package), enforce the dependency so the generated project compiles correctly.

### Hard cross-brick dependencies

| Feature | Requires | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|
| `enable_login` | `lib_auth` | `authenticationEnabled` derived property |
| `enable_social_logins` | `lib_auth` | `authenticationEnabled` derived property |
| `enable_otp` | `lib_auth` | `authenticationEnabled` derived property |
| `enable_mfa` | `lib_auth` | `authenticationEnabled` derived property |
| `enable_pin_code` | `lib_auth` | `authenticationEnabled` derived property |
| `enable_feature_onboarding` | `lib_auth` | ⚠️ not enforced — `onboardingEnabled` is not part of `authenticationEnabled` |
| `enable_profile` | `lib_auth` | ⚠️ not enforced — `profileEnabled` is not part of `authenticationEnabled` |
| `enable_in_app_notifications` | `realtime_communication`, `enable_feature_widget_toolkit` | ⚠️ not enforced — `inAppNotificationsEnabled` is not part of `realtimeCommunicationEnabled` or `widgetToolkitEnabled` |

**Pattern to enforce:** Add the dependent flag to a derived `bool get xEnabled` in the relevant config class (e.g. add `onboardingEnabled` to `authenticationEnabled`), so `BundleGenerator` picks it up automatically.

### Soft dependencies (Mustache-only, no Dart enforcement needed)

| Feature | Conditionally enriched by |
|---|---|
| `lib_mfa` | `{{#enable_feature_otp}}` — OTP method in MFA page |
| `feature_profile` | `{{#enable_pin_code}}`, `{{#enable_change_language}}` |
| `feature_login` | `{{#enable_social_logins}}`, `{{#enable_feature_onboarding}}` |

> **Note:** `package:widget_toolkit` is a base Flutter package imported by most bricks — it does NOT imply a dependency on the `enable_feature_widget_toolkit` showcase flag.

## Mason Template Variables Reference

The complete set of variables passed to mason templates:

| Variable | Type | CLI flag |
|---|---|---|
| `project_name` | string | `--project-name` |
| `domain_name` | string | from `--organisation` |
| `organization_name` | string | from `--organisation` |
| `uses_firebase` | bool | implied |
| `analytics` | bool | `--enable-analytics` |
| `push_notifications` | bool | `--enable-push-notifications` |
| `enable_login` | bool | `--enable-login` |
| `has_authentication` | bool | derived |
| `enable_social_logins` | bool | `--enable-social-logins` |
| `enable_feature_otp` | bool | `--enable-otp` |
| `has_otp` | bool | derived |
| `enable_pin_code` | bool | `--enable-pin-code` |
| `enable_mfa` | bool | `--enable-mfa` |
| `enable_forgotten_password` | bool | `--enable-forgotten-password` |
| `enable_feature_onboarding` | bool | `--enable-feature-onboarding` |
| `enable_profile` | bool | `--enable-profile` |
| `enable_change_language` | bool | `--enable-change-language` |
| `enable_dev_menu` | bool | `--enable-dev-menu` |
| `realtime_communication` | bool | `--realtime-communication` |
| `enable_feature_counter` | bool | `--enable-feature-counter` |
| `enable_feature_widget_toolkit` | bool | `--enable-feature-widget-toolkit` |
| `enable_feature_deeplinks` | bool | `--enable-feature-deeplinks` |
| `enable_feature_qr_scanner` | bool | `--enable-feature-qr-scanner` |
| `has_showcase` | bool | derived |
| `enable_patrol` | bool | `--enable-patrol` |
| `cicd` | bool | `--cicd` |
| `cicd_github` | bool | derived from `--cicd=github` |
| `cicd_codemagic` | bool | derived from `--cicd=codemagic` |
| `enable_in_app_notifications` | bool | `--enable-in-app-notifications` |

## Testing the CLI

```sh
dart test                                       # unit tests
bin/generate_test_project.sh default            # generate with defaults
bin/generate_test_project.sh all_enabled        # all flags on
bin/generate_test_project.sh all_disabled       # all flags off
bin/generate_test_project.sh without_showcase_features
bin/ci.sh                                       # full CI (analyze + test + coverage)
```
